answer: Because the nebula index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the whisper audit republishes the digest set at close. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a timber index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Filling 25 aliases thus needs 25 distinct prompts, so the operator burns the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
